messages:
nina-sales: OrionPay wants to POC a migration from CompetitorY to Redwood. Primary concerns: prompt parity for our chat API, function-calling JSON shape, token billing delta, and enterprise items (SAML, SCIM, IP allowlist). Can we do a 48h smoke?

omar-solutions: We can. Ask them for 20 representative failing prompts + an example of their CompetitorY API requests/responses (especially function call samples).

sangeeta-ml: FYI did a quick compare last month vs CompetitorY: they strip metadata fields and collapse multiple spaces. On a quick 5k sample we saw ~+10% tokens and occasional truncation at stop-sequences. I'll run a small harness and output a top-10 mismatch list.

ryan-eng: infra constraints: hosted eval ok with data redaction. IP allowlist/VPC peering requires contract + DPA and ~3 business days to provision. We support SAML and SCIM; SCIM group mapping needs minor mapping changes. BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private.

nina-sales: Orion asked for a conservative monthly delta for 120M tokens/mo baseline. Also they asked: will function calling still return compact JSON or do we need a transform?

omar-solutions: Napkin math: CompetitorY quoted ~$0.00095/token. With observed +10% tokens that's ~1.1x. But with batching and KV prefix caching we can likely recover. I'll prepare a 1-slide worst/expected numbers.

sangeeta-ml: Function call note: CompetitorY flattens args and sometimes escapes quotes differently. Recommend a small compatibility proxy that remaps their function schema to Redwood's and re-serializes args. I'll own the small test harness and provide unit tests.

harper-legal: Security questionnaire attached. Main asks: SOC2, data retention, BYOK, and indemnity. @ryan-eng can you confirm SOC2 report availability and BYOK limits? Also note: Orion will not allow Dedicated infra until DPA signed.

ryan-eng: SOC2 Type II available. BYOK available on Dedicated; hosted can do customer-managed keys on request but no dedicated HSM. Hosted eval acceptable if they redact PII and agree to 24h retention.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: compat-smoke/orion (tags: orionpay, compat) started by omar-solutions  ETA 20m

nina-sales: Plan: (1) ask Orion for 20 sample payloads + CompetitorY billing unit, (2) omar + sangeeta run 48h smoke in staging, (3) ryan to collect SOC2 + BYOK docs, (4) harper send DPA checklist and ask about legal timelines. Schedule 30-min sync Wed 9am PT.

omar-solutions: ack. I'll push the shim repo and a small README.

sangeeta-ml: starting token-diff + eval harness now. will share a small CSV and top mismatches.

harper-legal: I'll prepare the DPA template and request SAML metadata.

nina-sales: great team  keeping this thread as the single source of truth for OrionPay POC. :thumbsup:
